name: dbt
description: dbt Labs MCP server — project metadata, Semantic Layer, Discovery API, lineage and freshness

requirements: uv installed (runs dbt-mcp in an isolated environment)
A local dbt project for the CLI toolset
dbt platform account + service token for platform APIs
notes: Toolsets auto-disable when their required env vars are missing instead of erroring.
Remote (dbt-hosted) MCP is consumption-only: no CLI commands and no codegen.

This registration binds the READ-ONLY metadata toolsets. The write surface — trigger_job_run, retry_job_run, cancel_job_run and the self-hosted dbt CLI (run/build/test) — is declared in writeTools but is NOT bound by any blueprint yet.

Dry-run levers: execute_sql is hard-enforced to a single read-only SELECT; x-dbt-disable-tools can disable job-run tools; DISABLE_ADMIN_API / DBT_MCP_ENABLE_<TOOLSET> give an allowlist; compile/parse never write to the warehouse.
